summaryZh: Fisch 实验室研究妊娠疾病与暴露的分子机制，以改善母婴终身健康。重点包括体细胞突变在胎盘功能障碍中的作用、胎盘疾病的无创标志物，以及产前暴露与妊娠结局的联系；具体方法未明确。
researchQuestions: 体细胞突变在胎盘功能障碍中起什么作用？
产前暴露与妊娠结局有何关系？

evidence.quote: Active areas of research in Dr. Fisch’s lab include exploring the role of somatic mutations in placental dysfunction, identifying non-invasive biomarkers of placental disorders and investigating the relationship between prenatal exposures and pregnancy outcomes.
